text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Teio. —With each passing 
year, you grow remarkably stronger."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Prez! I feel like my body's 
catching up with my motivation more and 
more!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The legs that couldn't reach yesterday 
take one step further today! The hands 
that fell short yesterday reach even 
higher today! I can practically see the 
President's back in front of me now♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You will never catch up to me. —Not for 
all eternity.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that an absolute victory 
declaration?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not quite. Lately, I've been feeling it 
even more strongly: you're an entirely 
different type of Umamusume from me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I am the unyielding steel, you are the 
supple willow. With every birthday that 
passes, the young child I once knew 
continues to change...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It makes me feel terribly lonely—and yet 
so happy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio, truly, congratulations. Please, let 
me watch over your future for years to 
come.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! No matter how strong I get, Prez, 
I'll always be by your side, okay?!
